epbs_bid_gossip_validation.highlight: Bug: builder with exit in parent payload can submit invalid bid, blocking other builders
Agreed fix: ignore bids from builders with an exit in the previous full payload (Nico's suggestion)
Implementation: keep a map of exited builder addresses from previous payload; check pub key + source address match before rejecting

epbs_devnet_testing.highlight: Plan to test payloads with >8,192 deposits on DevNet 8; pk910 has tooling (batching contract) ready
Justin needs >8,000 ETH for top-ups; pk910 will supply testnet ETH

focil_gossip_checks.highlight: Proposal to add gossip check rejecting empty transactions in inclusion lists (FOCIL)
Teku already has this in their DevNet 0 branch (per chat)
Starting with 4,112 max inclusion list size; Jihoon to clean up consensus-specs PR and open new engine API PR

ptc_attestation_performance.highlight: Potuz: PTC attestation validation is a surprising CPU bottleneck alongside KZG data column checks
Root cause: no subnets for PTC attestations, so all messages are received by all nodes
Mitigation: move PTC validation to background thread; BLS and KZG offloaded to background improves performance significantly
Justin shared vkzg side project: offloads KZG cell recovery and proof computation to GPU via Vulkan

Include FOCIL devnet 0 changes in client DevNet 0 branches
